text:
Maya: Quick proposal — Emberline welcome wave: 3-stage APAC stagger tied to the benchmark webinar + benchmark CTA. Goal: avoid peak-hour spikes and tailor subject lines to local time.

Josh: Love it. Do we have cohort segmentation? new users past 7 days, trial starts, engaged docs readers?

Maya: Yes — cohorts: (1) 0-48h new signups, (2) trial active 3-10d, (3) docs-engaged >2 reads. Short copy variants per cohort.

Emma: For send times, suggest +1h after local 10am slot per timezone. Proposal: NZ/AUS 09:00-11:00, SG/HK 10:00-12:00, IN 09:00-10:30. Sam, ops feasibility?

Sam: Ops looks good. We need to schedule via campaign-runner and set batching windows. Also recommend rate limit to 6k/hr for AUS to avoid provider queueing.

Gina: Subject line tests: "See Redwood in action" vs "Benchmark insights + invite". Recommend including webinar date in preview and a dynamic token for model benchmark link.

Maya: Also include two CTAs: "Schedule a demo" (primary) and "Download benchmark deck" (secondary). Plan a 20/80 canary for CTA color test early.

Josh: I'll own copy + segment mapping. Emma owns send windows. Sam owns ops schedule, Gina handles creative assets. Maya will coordinate reporting & benchmarks.

Sam: Ops snippet (example config):
```
campaign: emberline-welcome-v1
batches_per_hour: 6
send_windows:
  - AUS: 2026-04-15T09:00:00+10:00/2026-04-15T11:00:00+10:00
  - SG: 2026-04-15T10:00:00+08:00/2026-04-15T12:00:00+08:00
  - IN: 2026-04-15T09:00:00+05:30/2026-04-15T10:30:00+05:30
rollout_pct: 20
```
I'll push the canary tomorrow morning.

Emma: :thumbsup: I'll map timezone offsets and update the master schedule sheet, add a column for provider send-capacity.

Gina: Creative mockups ready by EOD Tue — will attach 2 variants to the drive and include preview images for mobile + desktop.

Josh: Copy by EOD Wed. Plan to A/B subject + preview text on a 10k sample and report lift after 24h.

Maya: Reporting KPIs: CTR, webinar signups, benchmark downloads, deliverability (bounces/blocks). We'll flag if CTR drops >10% vs baseline.

deploy-bot: Campaign emberline-welcome-v1 created (id: cpn_89321). Canary scheduled for 2026-04-15 09:00 +10:00.

Maya: Great — please shout here if anything blocks. :rocket:
